title: Force smoothness and five-moment rebuttal adjudication

claims.claim: The manuscript treats the five moments as load-bearing but also assigns distinct residual-control roles to wave, covariance, auxiliary-time, pressure, cutoff, nonlinear, and summation operations.
Velocity norm blow-up alone does not imply termwise divergence of every residual summand.
The selected Lean force theorem is derived from actual residual-rate and locally uniform limit premises, not a bare NativeBounds assumption.
Upstream repaired finite identities feed concrete residual jet-rate and all-jets-flatness theorems.
The audit has not located a final endpoint theorem identifying the completed Cartesian fields and force with the paper tuple (M,I,J,S,Cp) after all selected transformations.

negative_results: No selected nonzero moment defect proved
